lines.text: On their late-fall camping trip, the sun drops at five, and Leo and Sam crawl into the tent, cold and bored.
Long nights don't have to end camp.
Hang a small lantern from the tent loop so camp stays lit without blinding anyone.
Sit on a foam pad instead of the cold ground.
Plan with a checklist so the warm layers come.
Their next camp night runs past nine.
Save this before your next camping trip.
